Name: Naioth
Description: The settlement near Ramah where Samuel's company of prophets lived, to which David fled from Saul, and where Saul's messengers, and then Saul himself, fell to prophesying instead of arresting him.
BiblicalSignificance: Naioth is where pursuit turned into prophecy: three bands of messengers and a king himself stopped to prophesy among the prophets.
